messages:
Maria Lopez: starting canary for crescent-slice feature branch now — aiming for 5% traffic slice at 10:30 PT. Kevin you good for smoke? :white_check_mark:
Kevin Park: yep, I'll run the smoke checklist + report within 10 minutes. ping me when traffic shifts live. @Maria
Deploy-bot: deploy initiated by Maria Lopez (commit abc1234) -> canary slice 5% -> target: prod-us-west. Status: IN_PROGRESS
Lucas Nguyen: I'll be rollback owner. If error rate > 2% sustained for 5m or latency p95 increases > 200ms, we roll back to v2.3. I'll be standing by.
Olivia Chen: quick config confirm — batch_size bumped to 4 in inference runtime? want to ensure KV cache warm is enabled for canary.
Maria Lopez: yes batch_size=4 and cache_warm=true. Doing a warmup of typical prefixes now.
Kevin Park: smoke steps (I'll paste commands):
```
# tail logs for the new pod
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=crescent-slice -f --tail=200

# run a small synthetic through the canary endpoint
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/crescent-slice/generate -d '{"prompt":"quick summary: redwood platform"}' | jq .
```
Kevin Park: running synthetic now -> first pass looks good, small token spike at t+30s but steady. No errors in pod logs.
Raj Patel: monitoring telemetry dashboard. I'll watch error rate and user-facing latency. Setting an alert for 2% error ceiling for the slice.
Deploy-bot: canary traffic shift completed -> 5% routed to canary (slice id: crescent-5pct). Health checks: OK (3/3).
Kevin Park: smoke complete. 0/100 failures on synthetic, sampling of 10 user requests looks normal.
Olivia Chen: double-checking rollout matrix — next step planned is 20% at +30m if no signals. Who will trigger?
Maria Lopez: I'll trigger the 20% bump at 11:00 PT unless anyone calls hold. Callout: if new errors observed, we immediate rollback. Lucas, you have the revert playbook?
Lucas Nguyen: revert playbook ready. Command to rollback is `./ops/deploy rollback --service crescent-slice --to v2.3` and I'll coordinate with infra to blackhole slice traffic.
Raj Patel: alerting configured. Also enabling detailed traces for this slice for the next hour.
Kevin Park: small request — please keep 30m of log retention for extra context in case we need to triage.
Maria Lopez: noted. I'll post a short status update in #eng-releases at +15m and again before the 20% bump.
Olivia Chen: we should also snapshot the evaluation prompts used in Optimize so we can run regressions if needed. I can take that.
Maria Lopez: thanks Olivia. Final check: anyone sees a reason to pause?
Kevin Park: all clear from smoke side.
Lucas Nguyen: good from rollback side.
Raj Patel: telemetry green.
Maria Lopez: ok proceeding — will bump to 20% at 11:00 PT if we stay green. :rocket:
